utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Hey Oren, what still needs fixing for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right — I think the porch light and that loose fence gate still need attention. I should check my list again, just to be sure.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Got it — should I bring a bulb, or do you want me to help with the gate?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds like the repair drive is coming together nicely—what do you need me to pick up while I’m out?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Could you grab a roll of duct tape, a pack of zip ties, and maybe a couple of extension cords? That’d help a ton.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Absolutely—I’ll grab those and swing back with them soon.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing, Hana — I can lend a hand with tools for the repair drive. Just let me know what you need.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Gus — I’ll check the list and let you know exactly which tools we need.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good — I’ll keep my toolbox ready and wait for your list.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh right, the repair drive — I meant to check on that today, but I got a bit sidetracked. What’s the latest?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: It’s still set for the community center parking lot this afternoon — I can swing by and confirm the table and donation bins are there.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Opal — that’d be great. I’ll try to stop by once I wrap up what I’m doing.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I heard the repair drive’s picking up nicely—people are bringing in all sorts of fix-it items. If you’re thinking of helping out, it sounds like a good day to stop by.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Yeah, maybe I’ll swing by later if I can manage it. I’m glad folks are turning out.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: For sure—last I heard they still need a hand sorting things, so even a quick stop would help. If you go, tell them Tess sent you by!

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m happy to help, but I’d like to know the timing and where everything needs to go first.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Absolutely — I’ll confirm the timing and the drop-off spot, then I’ll let everyone know.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, that helps. Please send me the details once you’ve got them, and I’ll plan around it.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I’m happy to help with the repair drive—what do you need me to do?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, thanks, Sam! Could you help organize donations and maybe spread the word to a few neighbors?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely—I can organize the donations and talk to a few neighbors today.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I can keep track of that—where’s the repair drive happening, and what time should I note?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: It’s over at the community center on Maple, starting at 2 PM this Saturday—come by whenever you can.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Got it—I’ll note the community center on Maple this Saturday at 2 PM. Thanks, Quinn.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Rey, I’m putting together a little repair-drive list and can spread the word fast if you want. If you’ve got anything that needs fixing, send it my way!

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Quinn — I’ve got a loose porch step that could use a look if you’re making a list. I appreciate you offering.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll add the porch step to the list and let folks know. If you want, I can swing by and make sure it gets seen soon.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I can help a little, but I need to keep it low-key right now.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Got it—how low-key do you need it, and what part can you handle?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I can help with sorting and carrying things, just not anything too public or noisy. If you keep it simple, I can do my part.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely — I’m starting to organize the repair drive and I’ll keep it running smoothly. Let me know what needs attention first.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Great, Rosa — I can help with a list of the biggest repairs first. Just tell me where to start.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Perfect — start with the most urgent fixes, and I’ll group them by house so we can tackle the block efficiently.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I’ll keep it brief—what do you need from me for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Just a quick hand sorting the donated tools and checking the signup sheet would be a huge help.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sure—I can sort the tools and check the signup sheet. Tell me where to start.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I’m ready to help, but I want to make sure I’ve got the details right first—what exactly needs repairing, and when is the drive scheduled?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: It’s mostly the porch rail and a leaky sink, and the repair drive is this Saturday morning at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Got it — porch rail and a leaky sink this Saturday morning at the community center. I’ll double-check what tools or materials are needed before I come.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Eli, sorry I’m late — how’s the repair drive going?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: No worries, Dane. It’s going fine — I’ve got a clear list and I’m just working through it one step at a time.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Glad to hear it. Want me to jump in and help with anything on the list?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help coordinate around the school schedule—what time is the repair drive, and where do you need me?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: That’d be a huge help, Faye — I’m still finalizing the time and spot, but I’ll let you know as soon as I’ve got it nailed down.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Sounds good—just send me the details when you’ve got them, and I’ll work it around pickup and drop-off.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Sounds good — I’m in for the repair drive. What do you need me to bring?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Mara — just bring a sturdy pair of gloves and maybe a flashlight if you’ve got one. I’ll handle the rest.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Got it — I’ll bring gloves and a flashlight.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I heard folks are organizing a repair drive? I’m still catching up, so what do you need me to know?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yeah, just bring any small fix-it stuff you’ve got, and we’ll sort it out at the drive. If you’re free, swing by and lend a hand too.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Got it — I’ll bring whatever small fix-it stuff I can find and stop by to help if I’m free.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I can help bring everyone together for the repair drive—who should I reach out to first?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Sure — can you confirm the top two people you’d contact first?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’d contact Sam and Priya first—they’re usually the quickest to rally. If you want, I can also loop in one backup person after that.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — I’ll skim the details and see what I can do for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Bo — I’ll keep track of what we still need and let you know if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Perfect — just point me at the key items if anything new comes up, and I’ll take a quick look.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, the repair drive is still happening today, right?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Yes, it’s still happening today. I’ll send the time and address shortly.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Got it — I’ll wait for the time and address.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can help with that—what still needs fixing for the drive?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Rey — we still need someone to check the folding tables, gather extra extension cords, and label the supply bins. If you can take one of those, I’d really appreciate it.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can take the folding tables and check them over. If anything looks off, I’ll let you know right away.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right, the repair drive — I’m a bit scattered today, but I’m happy to help. What do you need me to bring?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Oren — could you bring packing tape, a marker, and a couple of sturdy boxes? I’m trying to keep the repair drive organized so we don’t lose track of anything.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Absolutely — packing tape, a marker, and a couple sturdy boxes. I’ll swing by with them so we can keep everything organized.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’ll spread the word about the repair drive and remind folks about it.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Vik — I really appreciate you passing it along. I’ll keep an ear out for any updates.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: You got it — I’ll keep spreading the word and let folks know if I hear anything new.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ve got a running list of the supplies we still need for the repair drive. Tell me what’s already covered, and I’ll fill in the gaps.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’m a little late, but I can help fill in the gaps. What’s still on the list?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Great — I’ll check the list and mark off anything you cover. Right now I’m just waiting on the remaining gaps.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I’m happy to help with the repair drive. Let’s keep it simple—tell me what needs doing first, and I’ll stick to the plan.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Eli — first I need someone to sort the donated items and make a quick list of what still needs fixing. After that, we can split up the rest by school pickup times.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That sounds good to me. I’ll sort the donated items and make the list first, then we can plan the rest around pickup times.
